requirements.title: First-year preparation
requirements.summary: Four years of English, three of social studies, four of mathematics including algebra, geometry, trigonometry and precalculus; calculus preferred. Two to three years of science including chemistry or physics, both preferred. Computing is preferred.

requirements.title: Transfer preparation
requirements.summary: At least precalculus and chemistry or physics; computing courses are preferred. Internal transfers are accepted; students beyond the first two years should consult an advisor about remaining time.

notes: The catalog curriculum was read through the ordinary browser. Automated catalog access returned a JavaScript/bot-access shell; no access controls were bypassed. The adapter observes the accessible study-page identity and co-op requirement only.
The catalog calls its table a typical course sequence. This record preserves its inventory and alternatives without claiming a mandatory semester order.
Original numeric hours are preserved; normalized credit units and individual alternative-course amounts remain unverified. A repeated zero-hour co-op course is one identity plus a two-block rule.
Fall 2026 admission availability is not treated as evidence of actual first instruction. Activity and first-offered date remain unknown.
The MATH-190 row has an Immersion 3 annotation while a separate fourth-year Immersion 3 slot appears. No double-counting or waiver is inferred.
